items.title: Booking Holdings creates new enterprise division as AI reshapes travel planning
items.summary: The future for online travel agencies increasingly relies on scaling business-to-business travel platforms.

items.title: Nike lays out financial goals ahead of first investor day in 9 years
items.summary: Nike is hosting an investor day at its Oregon headquarters as the company tries to prove to investors that its turnaround is working.

items.title: U.S. officially loses measles elimination status amid ongoing outbreaks
items.summary: The director of PAHO made the final call that measles is endemic — or always present — in the U.S. following 12 months of continuous transmission.

items.title: FAA pauses installation of new routers after ground stop
items.summary: Problems with the overwhelmed technology led the agency to issue a rare nationwide ground stop on Friday.

items.title: Home Depot names Richard McPhail as new CEO, beats earnings expectations
items.summary: Home Depot named Richard McPhail as its new CEO effective next week.

items.title: Disney beats fourth-quarter estimates, targets $3 billion in savings through cost-cutting efforts
items.summary: Investors will be looking for more insight into CEO Josh D'Amaro's strategy following several rounds of layoffs.

items.title: Republicans outspent Democrats for first time in over a decade in record 2026 midterm election political ad blitz
items.summary: Republicans slightly outspent Democrats for the first time as Democrats swept national and state elections.

items.title: United Airlines resolves system outage that affected departing flights
items.summary: The airline said there was no impact on flights in progress and there was no indication the outage was a cyberattack.
